more_info.overview: Tragacanth is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include table-top sweeteners in liquid form, table-top sweeteners in powder form. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Collected as dried gum exudate from the stems and branches of Astragalus species. It is a mixture of plant polysaccharides.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The specified starting material is plant derived and compatible with vegetarian and vegan diets. The specification does not establish halal or kosher certification.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for assessed food uses.
Large short-term human intakes were tolerated, and the reviewed animal evidence did not indicate cancer.
